products.notes: Dual 2-ohm coils (1 ohm parallel / 4 ohm series). T/S (manual + product page) measured in 1-ohm (parallel) configuration: Revc ~1 ohm, Le 0.26 mH, Bl 7.65 Tm are for parallel wiring, so reOhms/leMh/bl omitted. Sensitivity 93 dB @2.83V/1m in 1-ohm config. Recommended amp 100-1000 W RMS. Sealed 17 L (0.6 cu ft); vented 28.3 L (1 cu ft) tuned 33 Hz. F3 low 24 Hz (upper limit printed as '200 kHz' typo). Depth 159 mm and cutout 235 mm read from manual dimension drawing (GB10 overall dia 272 mm). Basket displacement 3.15 L. Mmd 147 g, Cms 175 um/N.
